newsitem.title: BELGIUM: RESEARCH ALERT - Bekaert raised at Smeets.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bekaert raised at Smeets.

text.p: Brokerage Smeets, Verbaet & Co said on Wednesday it raised its recommendation for shares in Belgian steel wire and cord company Bekaert to 'buy' from 'sell'.
Smeets, Verbaet analyst Rolf Schorpion cited four reasons for the upgrade:
- steel cord prices were stabilising; the expectations for steel cord prices were good as small competitors wanted to quit and customers were asking for long-term contracts;
- the orderbook was well-filled; the backlog was three months, which was higher than in the first half of 1996;
- the perspectives for the growth markets (China, Brazil, Poland) looked promising in the long run;
- exports from Belarus decreased firmly; Bekaert now made steel cord of a higher quality and could even export to Belarus.
